# Spaceman

> Spaceman is a macOS tiling window manager for Apple silicon built around stable logical windows, native tab replacement, workspace routing rules, durable window restoration, and a local CLI.

Spaceman uses macOS Accessibility APIs with no SIP changes required. It provides ten numbered workspaces (`1`–`10`) plus opt-in named workspaces (`A`–`Z`), nested weighted split layouts, drag-to-reorder and resize, and automatic window restoration on pause, quit, or update.

## Documentation

- [Full documentation](https://spaceman.kitlangton.com/llms-full.txt): installation, keyboard shortcuts, configuration rules, CLI commands, and recovery guarantees
- [Website](https://spaceman.kitlangton.com/): overview and Apple silicon preview download
